description: Defines the fixed chat stamps (stickers) available in lobby and battle chat, including their sprite, caption, and character voice line.

Id.technical: FName row key. Selecting a stamp sends this ID in an EGameOnlineSendMessageType::Stamp network message; the receiving ChatMessageWidget resolves the row by Request.RowName in StampDataTables and uses the first matching table. The ID is not used for the sprite or text directly.

FileName.simple: Paper sprite asset name for the stamp image.
FileName.technical: FName. Stamp list entries resolve it with FindDynamicLoadSprite and set it on the stamp image; incoming stamp messages use the same field for ShowStampMessage. Lobby/battle-interval startup and WidgetTest also prefetch every stamp sprite as GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetSprite from this field.

Id_StampText.simple: Localized caption/button text for the stamp.
Id_StampText.technical: FName. Set as the stamp entry's button text with SetButtonTextId (EApplicationLanguage::Invalid), and copied into FGameStampMessageRequest::TextId for incoming chat stamps so the message text uses the row's caption.

Id_Voice.simple: Voice ID played when the stamp is sent/shown.
Id_Voice.technical: FName passed to AGameSoundManager::PlayVoiceById with the sender's character index. It is used on the receiving display path in ShowStampMessage; the export uses VoCha_* IDs matching the stamp's character.

notes: The export contains 31 rows. Multiple StampDataTable shards are supported; incoming messages scan tables in order and use the first matching row.
The stamp list is built from all rows in StampDataTables and paired with the chat list in UGameCommonChatListWidget::InitializeWidget; no separate ownership/progress field exists in this row.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Builds the selectable stamp list from all rows.
Sends the selected row's Id as a Stamp chat message.
Displays each stamp's caption and sprite.
Resolves an incoming stamp row and shows its text, sprite, and voice.
Prefetches all stamp sprites for the visual lobby/battle chat.
Prefetches all stamp sprites for PvE battle intervals.
